Rashi on Gittin 67b:10:1.hebrew: נשתתק - לאו אשאחזו קורדייקוס קאי, אלא אדם שנעשה אלם מחמת חולי:
Rashi on Gittin 67b:10:1.english: Became mute - [This] does not refer to [one] who was seized by kordiakos [delirium], rather [to] a person who became mute due to illness:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:10:2.hebrew: הרכין - הטה, "ויט שמים" מתרגמינן "וארכין שמיא" (תהילים י״ח:י׳):
Rashi on Gittin 67b:10:2.english: He nodded - [This means] he inclined [his head]; [similarly, the verse] "He bowed the heavens" (Psalms 18:10) is translated [into Aramaic] as *ve'arkin shemaya* ("and He inclined the heavens"):

Rashi on Gittin 67b:10:3.hebrew: בודקין אותו - בדברים אחרים, שואלין לו דברים שהוא ראוי להשיב עליהן; אם ראו דעתו מיושבת, שמרמז על תשובת לאו הרכנה שדרך בני אדם להרכין על לאו, ועל הין הרכנת הין, שלשה פעמים לכל אחד — כותבין ונותנין, אם מרכין על הגט הרכנת הין:
Rashi on Gittin 67b:10:3.english: They examine him - with other matters: they ask him things that he is capable of answering. If they see [that] his mind is settled — that he indicates an answer of "no" [with] a nod in the way people nod for "no," and for "yes" [with] a nod of "yes," three times for each — they write and give [the bill of divorce], if he nods for the bill of divorce [with] a nod of "yes."

Rashi on Gittin 67b:11:1.hebrew: נכתיה - נשכו, כלומר ששתה הימנו והרגיש בו:
Rashi on Gittin 67b:11:1.english: Nakhtei - [It] bit him, that is to say, he drank from it and felt [its effect] upon him:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:11:2.english: Ruḥa [spirit] - A demon that seizes [a person] through this:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:12:1.english: For an amulet - for through it they adjure the spirit by its name:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:13:1.english: For a one-day sun[-fever] - An illness that seized him due to heat on that same day:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:13:2.english: A jug of water - [he should] drink:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:13:6.english: The middle of his head - Of the sick person:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:14:1.english: That the world grows faint for him - his heart grows faint:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:14:2.hebrew: ולימוד - ישוט, כמו "נחית בר אמוראי" (ב"ב דף עד:):
Rashi on Gittin 67b:14:2.english: And let him submerge - [This means] he shall swim [or dive], as in, "A diver descended" (Bava Batra 74b):

Rashi on Gittin 67b:15:1.english: For a fever, red meat, etc. - As [Abaye] said [above]:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:15:2.english: For the chills - An illness that seized him on account of cold:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:16:1.hebrew: הוו מצערי ליה - העבדים, מפני שהיה חסיד ופרוש ומחמיר עליהן באיסורין:
Rashi on Gittin 67b:16:1.english: They would afflict him - [i.e.,] the servants, because he was pious and abstemious and was strict with them regarding [halachic] prohibitions:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:17:1.hebrew: ילתא - אשת רב נחמן, והיא בת הנשיא ואשת אב בית דין וחשובה, כדאמרי' בהעור והרוטב (חולין דף קכד.) דרב נחמן חתנא דבי נשיאה הוה:
Rashi on Gittin 67b:17:1.english: Yalta - [She was] the wife of Rav Nachman, and she was the daughter of the Nasi and the wife of the Av Beit Din [head of the court], and [thus] a prominent [woman], as we say in [the chapter] HaOr VeHaRotev (Chullin 124a), that Rav Nachman was the son-in-law of the house of the Nasi:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:17:3.hebrew: דמתהפכי - מחמת זיעה אדומה היוצאה ממנו ע"י בשרא שמינא וחמרא חייא:
Rashi on Gittin 67b:17:3.english: That [they] turned [into blood] - because of red sweat emerging from him due to [the] fatty meat and undiluted wine:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:18:1.hebrew: רב יוסף איעסק - לתלגא בריחים, כדי שיחמם ויזיע:
Rashi on Gittin 67b:18:1.english: Rav Yosef busied himself - [as a remedy] for the cold, with millstones, so that he would warm up and sweat:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:18:2.english: With beams - To carry beams and loads:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:1:1.english: And there are [those] who reverse them - [Referring to] Rabbah and Rav Yosef:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:20:1.english: Set out the portions of the animal for me - Arrange before me the pieces of the animal, piece by piece:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:20:2.english: Ahdemu [Cut into pieces] - Dismember [it], that is to say, arrange the pieces:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:21:1.english: He said to him - The Exilarch [said this]:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:21:2.english: If so - that it is because they are suspect:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:21:3.english: They should prepare [it] before [my] Master's attendant - That is to say, before [my] Master's attendant they will prepare the food in a permitted manner:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:21:5.hebrew: ריסתנא דחנקא חמתא - אמנשטריישו"ן, עצם קטן שעל כף הירך שאדם בולעו ונחנק; והניחוהו לפניו משום דרב ששת סגי נהור הוה, ולא יראנו, ויאכל ויחנק:
Rashi on Gittin 67b:21:5.english: *Ristana dechanka chamta* - [In Old French:] *amnestrison*, a small bone on the hip socket that a person swallows and chokes on; [they placed it before him] because Rav Sheshet was blind, and would not see it, and would eat [it] and choke:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:21:6.english: He felt it - He touched it and sensed that bone:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:21:7.english: He took - [He took] the entire piece [of meat], and wrapped it in his scarf:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:2:1.hebrew: ע"י כולן - בשביל כולן:
Rashi on Gittin 67b:2:1.english: By the hand of them all - [meaning] on behalf of all of them:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:2:2.english: [One] brings [it] in the presence of all of them - All of them must go with him:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:3:1.hebrew: מנה מהו - אם לא אמר "כולכם", אבל מנאן א', ב', ג', ד', ואמר "כתבו גט לאשתי", מהו? מדמננהו, לכולהו הנך מנויין איכוון, או דלמא כיון דלא אמר להו "כולכם המנויין כתבו", לא בעינן כולם:
Rashi on Gittin 67b:3:1.english: [If] he enumerated [them], what is [the law] - If he did not say "all of you," but he enumerated them — one, two, three, four — and said, "Write a bill of divorce for my wife," what is [the law]? Since he enumerated them, did he intend all of those who were enumerated [to be required], or perhaps, since he did not say to them, "All of you who are enumerated, write," we do not require all of them:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:4:1.hebrew: אמרי לה להאי גיסא - מנה כולהו — אכולהו קפיד. מנה מקצתייהו — לא קפיד אלא אמנויין: "השנים מהני מנויין חתמו" למעוטי השאר שלא נמנו אתא, ולא לכל הני מנויין איכוין שיחתמו כולם; כיון דלא מנה לכולהו הוברר שטורח הדבר עליו וחדל לו מדעתו הראשונה, ואפי' המנויין אינם צריכין לחתום אלא מקצתן:
Rashi on Gittin 67b:4:1.english: Some say [it] in this manner - [If] he enumerated all of them, he is particular about all of them. [If] he enumerated some of them, he is not particular except regarding the enumerated ones: [he is saying], "Two of these enumerated ones sign," [which] comes to exclude the rest who were not enumerated, and he did not intend for all of these enumerated ones to sign; since he did not enumerate all of them, it became clear that the matter was a burden on him and he desisted from his initial intention, and even [of] the enumerated ones, only some of them need to sign:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:4:2.hebrew: ואמרי לה להאי גיסא - מנה מקצתן, גלי דעתיה דאהני קפיד, וצריכין כולן המנויין לחתום; מנה כולן, כיון דלא אמר "כולכם", לא הקפיד אלא לומר בפני מנין זה, ולא שיחתמו כולם:
Rashi on Gittin 67b:4:2.english: And some say it in that manner - [If] he enumerated some of them, he revealed his intent that he is particular about these [individuals], and all of those enumerated must sign; [if] he enumerated all of them, since he did not say "all of you," he was not particular [that they all sign], only meaning to say [that it should be done] in the presence of this group, and not that all of them must sign:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:5:1.hebrew: אתקין רב יהודה בגיטא דכולכם - בגט שאדם אומר במעמד רבים, ויש לחוש שמא יאמר "לכולכם איכוין" ולא יחתמו כולם, ונמצא גט בטל — התקין שיהו כותבין בו: כך אמר לנו פלוני, "כתבו או כולכון או כל חד מנכון". "כולכון" — אחד כותב במעמד כולם; "או כל חד מנכון" — אפי' אין חביריו עמו:
Rashi on Gittin 67b:5:1.english: Rav Yehuda instituted in [the case of] a bill of divorce of "all of you" - Regarding a bill of divorce where a person speaks in the presence of many [people], and there is concern lest he say, "I meant all of you," and not all of them will sign, and the bill of divorce will be found [to be] invalid — he instituted that they should write in it: Thus said So-and-so to us, "Write, either all of you or each one of you." "All of you" [means] one writes in the presence of all of them; "or each one of you" [means] even [if] his fellows are not with him:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:6:1.english: And [it] will come to be invalidated - lest one of them not be present at its writing, or not all of them will sign [it]:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:7:1.english: Sign, any two of you - And a person should not say, "All of you":

Rashi on Gittin 67b:9:1.english: One whom kordeyakos has seized - [This is] the name of a demoness who takes control [of a person] when he drinks much wine from his winepress:

Rashi on Gittin 67b:9:2.english: He said nothing - because his mind is not settled:

Tosafot on Gittin 67b:10:1.hebrew: בודקין אותו שלש פעמים - פי': שלש פעמים על לאו ושלש פעמים על הן, דהיינו ששה פעמים בין הכל. ובגמרא דקאמר "וניחוש דלמא שיחיא דלאו לאו נקטיה, אי נמי שיחיא דהן הן" — לאו משום דלא ניבעי תרוייהו, דתרוייהו בעינן כדפירשנו, אלא כלומר: ובחד מהן, או בלאו או בהן, אינו בדעתו. וי"ס דל"ג "אי נמי". ובדיקה זו מפרש בירושלמי: כיצד בודקין לאו והן? אומרים לו: "נכתוב גט לאשתך?" אומר "הן". "לאמך?" אומר "לאו". "לאחותך?" אומר "לאו". "לבתך?" אומר "לאו", כו':
Tosafot on Gittin 67b:10:1.english: They examine him three times - Meaning: three times for "no" and three times for "yes," which is six times in all. And in the Gemara, where it says, "And let us be concerned that perhaps a spasm of 'no, no' seized him, or else a spasm of 'yes, yes'" — [this is] not because we do not require both, for we do require both as we explained; rather, it means: even in one of them, either in "no" or in "yes," he is not in his right mind. And there are texts that do not read "or else." And this examination is explained in the Jerusalem Talmud: How do they examine "no" and "yes"? They say to him, "Shall we write a bill of divorce for your wife?" He says, "Yes." "For your mother?" He says, "No." "For your sister?" He says, "No." "For your daughter?" He says, "No," etc.:

Tosafot on Gittin 67b:21:1.hebrew: כרכה בסודריה - משום דאשכח ביה טעמא דחיורא הוא דעבד הכי, והגמרא לא פירשו עד לבסוף:
Tosafot on Gittin 67b:21:1.english: He wrapped it in his scarf - It was because he found in it the taste of diseased meat [from an animal afflicted with boils] that he did so, and the Gemara did not explain it until the end:

Tosafot on Gittin 67b:9:1.hebrew: מי שאחזו קורדייקוס ואמר כתבו גט לאשתי לא אמר כלום - ואפי' אמר כתבו ותנו:
Tosafot on Gittin 67b:9:1.english: One who was afflicted with kordeyakos and said, "Write a bill of divorce for my wife," has said nothing - And even if he said, "Write and give [it]":
